techs.title: Diver Bhop
techs.summary: One of the most Integral Techs for Diver movement.

blocks.content:
This tech is really necessary for precise movement and Early game gift collection.
It's also really useful for surviving Kolona if you forgot your number!

You should also do this tech if you get [[icon:Ninja Belt]] as its fundamental for Late game gift collection (but be careful or you're gonna fly off...)

Prerequisites:
2 Hands (Optional)
A pulse (Optional)
Early game gift collection is going to be much harder without this tech because a simple dive will make you fly over most gifts!
You can also chain this tech!

Do a dive [[icon:Diver]]
Wait a tiny bit (or don't)
Jump

blocks.caption: This Should be roughly the timing for the bhop (Its really not too precise)

blocks.content:
This is a Late Game (LVL 20+) Tech, You will need [[icon:Miniature Hourglass]] for this.

This is very easy to learn Tech, and the way it works is just:

Jump
After reaching the Peak Height of the jump, Place your Statue
Teleport back as soon as you can, then Immediately jump
